articles.title: Coinbase-backed Stand With Crypto calls on members to campaign against banks blocking digital asset transactions
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto UK is telling its members to file formal complaints with high-street banks over sector-wide transfer bans.

articles.title: Crypto outflows are sentiment shock, not structural crisis: CoinShares' Butterfill
articles.snippet: CoinShares’ James Butterfill said recent crypto outflows reflect a macro-driven sentiment shock, while other analysts warned Bitcoin’s rebound may remain fragile.
